note: What a server sends to lay a new look over a unit's own. The header names the unit.

fields.name: entry
fields.note: Names this look, so that AppearancePopped can name it.

bits.name: overrideSpells
bits.note: Set where the unit's spells change with it.

bits.name: modelOnly
bits.note: Set where only the model changes.

bits.name: replacePackage
bits.note: Set where its art and sound change with it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look; -1 keeps the unit's own skin.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads it under, ended by a zero byte. A client reads it from a 64-byte field, so a name and its zero take at most 64 bytes.

revisions.note: A client stops a basic attack the unit is making first. Looks stack: the newest shows, and AppearancePopped takes away the one its entry names. An animated building instead looks for a look of the same name whose skin equals entry, adds the look under skin where it finds none, and reads nothing of how.
